source: ADR 062 step 6 — the table-lane benchmark. Frozen questions over CBS tables that are NOT in the curated showcase set (src/ingestion/registry-seed.ts), so the curated lane cannot answer them and the table lane must. The table is given per task (it stands in for the finder's pick, which the job receives); the finder has its own calibration (tablefinder:eval). Every question is held out: none is in benchmark/tableparse-labelled-set.json, so the acceptance threshold is never tuned on these. Task text is frozen; changing it means re-recording (tableparse:record).

gate.answerableMinReason: 12 of the 14 answer tasks (85.7%) — exactly the curated benchmark's floor (12 of 14, docs/03). ADR 062's revisit trigger is the table lane scoring below the curated lane's quality floor, so the lane must meet the same share. The 9 refuse/ask tasks must ALL pass (an ask task passes only when the button question is right AND the answer after the click matches the key — the curated clarify-task rule), and invented numbers must be 0, exactly like the curated gate.
